basis: Original Muse Spark, April 8 launch: Artificial Analysis launch-era Intelligence Index 52 (April 2026 edition), not the later rebased 43, gives reasoning 4.5. The Batch reports text/image/speech input and about 262k context: modalities 4, context 2.5. Coding null: published Terminal-Bench 2.0/Hard is not the rubric’s Terminal-Bench 4.0. Price null: no public API tariff at launch; free consumer access is not a zero token price. Speed null: no verified launch tokens/s. Three independent sources: AA early-access benchmarks, DataCamp hands-on tests and Tom’s Guide hands-on assessment; do not borrow 1.1/1.3 figures.
